headline: 25 of 27 held tickers returned 1579 daily rows each (2020-06-29..2026-10-09); 2 were empty (CEM, FPNIX), 0 errors. Close and Adj Close differ in 25 of 25 returned. On shared dates the build close tracks the fetched unadjusted Close (reading: {'looks unadjusted': 25, 'no fetched close': 2}). NOT CUSTODIAN-VALIDATED.
not_established: No reading is custodian-validated: none of these funds has a reinvestment row, so the custodian price cannot confirm the fetched close.

Readings use thresholds set by the worker: fewer than 20 shared dates = too few dates; looks adjusted if at least half of shared dates have ratio below 0.98, else looks unadjusted. A fund whose ratio sits near 1 may also be unadjusted-by-construction if it paid nothing.

VBTLX shares 1482 dates with the build, with min ratio 0.1823 and 7.83 percent of dates below 0.98 (the ratio does not rise toward the present); the cause (build price anomaly or unit mismatch) was not investigated.
CEM and FPNIX returned nothing (CEM: no timezone found / not found; FPNIX: no price data found, matching the existing cache marker); left unretried, no marker file written for them in the new folder.
yfinance 1.2.0 may retry internally on HTTP errors; no switch was found to disable it, so internal retry is not ruled out.
The fetched files are local and uncommitted; their sha256 is in the csv.
